title: HARM clock-domain map, version 1
description: The clock domains of a design (H35, D-043), written by harm-coi --domains from the RTL alone. Names are RTL paths below the top, with '::' between scopes. Lists are sorted.

clocks.description: one domain per clock root, sorted by name

name.description: the clock root: a process's clock followed back through single-source wires and ports

derived.description: the root is driven by logic or by a register (a gate, a divider)

from.description: for a derived clock: the domains it is made from

resets.description: the roots of its registers' asynchronous controls

reads_resets.description: of the resets given with --reset, those its registers read (asynchronously or through their logic)

crossings.description: a register of one domain reaching a register of another through wires and logic, sorted by (to, into, signal)

synchronizers.description: 2-flop chains: first is fed through wires only by one foreign register, second only by first; sorted by (clock, first, second)

unclocked.description: registers whose clock cannot be told from their asynchronous controls
